source.summary: GitHub Actions ‘Embedder footprint’ runs for PR #306 (branch fix/199-aot-wast-lane at head eef51447f4e4f29c9ab2efbdb69c87bc0302a96c — the #199 change (offline AoT artifact producer for ‘telomere compile’, fail-closed CLI load path, library frontend phase counters, AoT wast lane on both targets; commit 1c93b4b) merged with current main bfc30e4 (PRs #305 and #307); ubuntu-24.04, Rust 1.96.0): workflow_dispatch runs 45522121233 and 45522128552 against the branch and pull-request run 45522077059, which built the same tree, produced byte-identical sizes for every gated series
source.derivation: Re-baseline for PR #306 (#199, telomere compile: offline AoT artifact producer, fail-closed CLI load path, and the AoT wast lane on both targets). Attribution was isolated by measuring current main alone three times (workflow_dispatch runs 45522134432, 45522139809 and 45522144666 on main at bfc30e4ae848f45bc99371ae50272d2c5b1ec2d2; all three runs pass the gate). The main control reproduces the checked-in baseline exactly on 28 of the 32 gated series; on the four release-size core-aot/core-jit series it measures 16–32 B below the baseline (stripped file -32 B and stripped .text -32 B in core-jit, -16 B / -16 B in core-aot), a main-side shrink since the PR #304 re-baseline tree (ba0feb7, which predates the merges of PRs #302, #303 and #304 and PR #305's minimal-embedder instances bin), so no part of the gate failure is main-side growth. This PR's own delta against the main control is small and nearly uniform: the embedder-linked part of the change is confined to the library frontend phase counters (common/frontend_phases.rs) and their wiring, while the producer and the CLI load path live in the telomere-cli binary the minimal embedder does not link, and the AoT wast lane is CI configuration. In release, stripped file / stripped .text grow +48 B / +48 B in core and core-nosimd, +32 B / +48 B in core-aot, +64 B / +64 B in core-jit, and +384 B / +384 B in component, wasi and wasi-threads; in release-size the growth is +16 B to +64 B across the library configurations (largest: core-jit stripped file +64 B). The baseline configuration, which links no library code, is byte-identical in both profiles. Against the checked-in baseline the gate therefore tripped on 28 of the 32 gated series. Against the original #164 baseline, the largest cumulative growth remains the release core-nosimd stripped file series at +9.83% (1,275,448 B to 1,400,840 B), followed by the release component stripped file series at +9.79% (2,433,656 B to 2,671,912 B). The core-aot configuration, added by PR #267 after the #164 baseline, is not part of the cumulative comparison. Run-to-run spread was 0 B for every gated series across the three branch samples and across the three main samples.
